steps.purpose: 극화체로 다시 그리기
steps.prompt: Completely REDRAW as an unmistakably DRAWN vintage Korean dramatic comic (geukhwa) panel. This must look like black ink marks on plain white paper, NOT like a photograph with a filter. Dominant bold variable-width BLACK outlines; angular deliberately simplified faces and anatomy, eyes drawn with a few pen strokes, noses drawn with a single angular line, hair a solid black silhouette with only 2-3 white highlights. Expression pushed through eyebrows and mouth shape. LARGE flat black shadow shapes and mostly WHITE unshaded skin. Hard-edged flat cel shading, sparse visible halftone dots, just 3 flat spot colors (dusty ochre, muted teal, brick red) over black and white. Background architecture simplified to confident perspective lines and flat fills. Recognizable concrete props but remove microtexture. Draw wrinkles with 2-4 intentional ink strokes. No gradients, no skin pores, no photographic lighting, no volumetric rendering, no detailed fabric or wood texture, no soft painterly washes, no sepia photographic filter, no 3D, no glossy webtoon style. Serious adult crime/drama comic, not chibi or cute caricature. Single panel, original artwork, no artist imitation.  Image 1 is EDIT TARGET for the existing scene, people, actions, props, and composition ONLY. Image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE: match its bold ink, simplified graphic faces, flat fills, black and white contrast, and angular character designs. Reinterpret every person in the edit target as a DRAWN comic character. Keep the same scene, action, people count, and important props of image 1, but completely replace its realistic rendering with image 2's printed dramatic comic aesthetic. Keep 16:9 landscape. No lettering, captions, logos or speech bubbles.
